top_choice_rationale: P001 (GLP-1 physiology and bioactive form; Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) is a mature, independently replicated chain from incretin physiology through identification of the active peptide to randomized outcome trials in diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular/renal disease. The three-laureate allocation and the citation scope are coherent and the achievement is clearly award-worthy, so it is preferred to no award.
